channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
item.description: The air traffic control system’s overloaded, antiquated telecommunications equipment sustained its latest widespread failure, prompting a call for more money to fuel faster upgrades.

item.title: NPR: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
item.description: Chile's far-right President José Antonio Kast is facing mounting public anger, as rising fuel prices trigger transport strikes and protests across the country.

item.title: BBC News: Young people should have legal guarantee of job or training, Milburn tells BBC
item.description: The author of a major review on youth unemployment, due next week, acknowledges the change would mean some young people losing out on benefits.

item.description: Regulator said Meta's 'lack of cooperation' and the large number of people affected contributed to size of the fine.

item.description: Radiation and collisions reshape the planetary building materials.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: What Would It Take for Me to Start Tracking My Kids’ Locations?
item.description: My son went missing for 18 interminable hours. I still think relying on technology to keep kids safe yokes families into a state of complacency.
